en.headline: Handmade Hong Kong stages first Discovery Bay Christmas market this weekend
en.dek: Local makers sell gifts and decorations at Discovery Bay Plaza from 11am to 6pm on Saturday and Sunday.
body: Handmade Hong Kong is holding its first Discovery Bay Christmas market of the season this weekend at Discovery Bay Plaza. The market runs from 11am to 6pm on both Saturday and Sunday.

Organisers said the stalls feature local creators offering Christmas decorations, homewares, jewellery and other gift items, along with food and drink stalls. It is one of several weekend sessions planned through December.
The market is open to the public. Visitors can reach Discovery Bay by ferry from Central Pier 3, then walk a short distance to the plaza.
Further sessions are scheduled for 28–29 November and 12–13 December at the same location, according to the organisers’ calendar.

zh.headline: 手作香港在愉景灣廣場辦首個聖誕市集 本周末舉行
zh.dek: 本地創作者於愉景灣廣場擺檔售賣禮品及裝飾，周六及日上午11時至下午6時開放。
body: 手作香港本周末在愉景灣廣場舉辦今季首個愉景灣聖誕市集。市集於周六及日上午11時至下午6時舉行。
主辦單位表示，檔位由本地創作者提供聖誕裝飾、家居用品、首飾及其他禮品，並設有飲食攤位。這是計劃至12月的多個周末場次之一。
市集向公眾開放。訪客可乘渡輪從中環三號碼頭前往愉景灣，抵步後步行短距離即可到達廣場。
根據主辦單位日程，另有11月28至29日及12月12至13日的場次，同樣在愉景灣廣場舉行。
